description: BM2 Convex Auth v2 Migration: move BM2 from the custom JWT auth to Convex Auth v2 (username and password) with the contract and the spike result of math-app-base_20261114, move each BM2 server call to the access token, then remove packages/core-auth and the old auth context of packages/app-shell. Depends on the track set unified-math-app_20261114. Runs before prod-deploy-pipeline_20261114 and Practice Primitives Tracks A to F.

sprint.goal: BM2 users sign in through Convex Auth v2, each server call of BM2 reads user data with the access token, and packages/core-auth is gone.

stories.title: Convex Auth v2 sign-in and accounts in BM2
BM2 server calls use the access token
Remove the custom JWT auth from the repository
